question:
Choose the idiom/phrase that can substitute the highlighted group of words meaningfully.

The matter is very serious and delicate. So, I urge you t**o behave or speak carefully to avoid causing problem. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"To tread carefully"** means **to behave or speak cautiously to avoid causing trouble or offending someone.** (सावधानीपूर्वक व्यवहार करना)

 
 
• **Example:** With such a sensitive issue at hand, you need to tread carefully to avoid making the situation worse.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **To tread carefully**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **In the dark** (अंधेरे में होना / जानकारी ना होना): Uninformed or unaware of something.

 
 
• **Example:** The employees were kept in the dark about the company's merger plans.
 
 
 
• **Cut corners** (शॉर्टकट लेना / जरूरी बातें छोड़ देना): To do something in the easiest or cheapest way, usually by omitting some necessary steps.
 
 
• **Example:** Don't cut corners on this project; ensure everything is done properly.
 
 
 
• **Beat around the bush** (घूम-फिर कर बात करना): To avoid getting to the point of an issue.
 
 
• **Example:** Stop beating around the bush and tell me what you want to say.
